en.title: bl
en.summary: This is the letter L333 from the alphabet vowel-consonant groups.

sections.title: The letters bl
paragraphs: The letters bl make a smooth blend. You hear this sound in (black) /blæk/, the color of night. This pair has one sound.

sections.title: How to say bl
paragraphs: First close both lips tight. Open them and place your tongue tip against the ridge behind your upper teeth. Let the air flow over the sides of your tongue. Touch your throat to feel your voice shake throughout both parts.

sections.title: Spelling rules for bl
paragraphs: This spelling appears at the start of a word or syllable. You say this sound in (blue) /blu/. You also hear it clearly in (blind) /blaɪnd/.

sections.title: Common mistakes with bl
paragraphs: Do not drop the second consonant. Do not insert a tiny vowel between the two letters. Move your lips and tongue together in one smooth glide.
